$doc: RCAI per-frame CPU budgets (P0-a). Values are milliseconds of CPU per frame at the stated actor load. The in-game profiler (RCAIDumpProf) emits CSV consumed by tools/perf_report.py, which gates against these budgets in CI and release soaks.

perception.doc: sight cones, hearing, smell for all active actors in cell

squad.doc: role assignment, alert propagation, memory ledger

jank_gate_doc: a single frame > 25 ms during an RCAI soak is a regression (visible hitch at 60 Hz)
